sentences.english: This is my first time here.
sentences.chinese: 这是我第一次来这里。

sentences.english: First, wash your hands, and then you can help me cook dinner.
sentences.chinese: 先洗手，然后你可以帮我做晚饭。

sentences.english: The first time I tried to ride a bike without training wheels, I fell into a bush and my dad had to pull me out, but I got back on and kept trying.
sentences.chinese: 我第一次尝试不用辅助轮骑车时，摔进了灌木丛，爸爸不得不把我拉出来，但我又骑上去继续尝试。
sentences.scene: 回忆学骑车的难忘经历

sentences.english: Wait a second, I'm almost ready.
sentences.chinese: 等一秒钟，我快好了。

sentences.english: She won second place in the race and was really proud of herself.
sentences.chinese: 她在赛跑中得了第二名，非常自豪。

sentences.english: I was going to be late, but the elevator door opened at the last second and I squeezed in, making it to the meeting just in time.
sentences.chinese: 我快要迟到了，但电梯门在最后一秒打开，我挤了进去，刚好赶上了会议。

sentences.english: He lives on the third floor.
sentences.chinese: 他住在三楼。

sentences.english: This is the third time I've watched this movie, and it still makes me cry.
sentences.chinese: 这是我看这部电影的第三次了，它还是能让我落泪。
sentences.scene: 表达对一部电影的喜爱

sentences.english: I was third in line for concert tickets, but by the time I reached the window, the best seats were already gone, so I had to settle for the back row.
sentences.chinese: 我排第三个买演唱会门票，但轮到我时最好的座位已经没了，我只好将就着买后排的。

sentences.english: My birthday is on the fourth of July.
sentences.chinese: 我的生日在七月四号。

sentences.english: The fourth question on the test was the hardest, and I spent ten minutes on it.
sentences.chinese: 试卷上第四道题最难，我花了十分钟做它。

sentences.english: We went to watch the fireworks on the Fourth of July, and after the show, we got stuck in traffic for almost two hours.
sentences.chinese: 我们七月四号去看烟花，看完后堵在路上快两个小时。

sentences.english: He finished fifth in the swimming race.
sentences.chinese: 他在游泳比赛中得了第五名。

sentences.english: Take the elevator to the fifth floor, and my office is on the right.
sentences.chinese: 坐电梯到五楼，我的办公室在右边。

sentences.english: This is the fifth time my favorite team has lost in the finals, and I'm starting to think they're just unlucky.
sentences.chinese: 这是我最喜欢的球队第五次在决赛中输球了，我开始觉得他们只是运气不好。

sentences.english: His birthday is on the twelfth of May.
sentences.chinese: 他的生日在五月十二号。

sentences.english: She was the twelfth person to arrive, just before the doors closed.
sentences.chinese: 她是第十二个到达的人，就在门关上之前到了。

sentences.english: I live on the twelfth floor, and sometimes when the elevator breaks down, I have to walk all the way up, which is a great workout but also exhausting.
sentences.chinese: 我住在十二楼，有时电梯坏了，我只能一路爬上去，这锻炼效果不错，但也累人。

sentences.english: The twentieth of June is our anniversary.
sentences.chinese: 六月二十号是我们的纪念日。

sentences.english: She was the twentieth customer in line, but luckily they still had enough stock.
sentences.chinese: 她是排第二十个顾客，但幸好还有足够的货。

sentences.english: My grandfather just celebrated his twentieth year of retirement, and he says he has never been busier in his life, always working on projects around the house.
sentences.chinese: 我爷爷刚刚庆祝了退休二十周年，他说他这辈子从没这么忙过，总在忙着家里的各种项目。

sentences.english: Her twelfth birthday party was amazing.
sentences.chinese: 她的十二岁生日派对棒极了。

sentences.english: We're reading the twelfth chapter of the book, and the story is finally getting exciting.
sentences.chinese: 我们读到这本书的第二十一章，故事终于变得精彩了。

sentences.english: On my twelfth birthday, my friends took me to a karaoke place, and even though I can't sing at all, it was one of the best nights of my life.
sentences.chinese: 我十二岁生日那天，朋友们带我去了卡拉OK，尽管我根本不会唱歌，但那一晚是我人生中最棒的夜晚之一。

sentences.english: My locker number is twenty-third from the left.
sentences.chinese: 我的储物柜是从左数第二十三个。

sentences.english: The twenty-third of December is always crazy because everyone is doing last-minute shopping.
sentences.chinese: 十二月二十三号总是很疯狂，因为大家都在做最后一刻的采购。

sentences.english: I was the twenty-third person to cross the finish line in the marathon, and even though I didn't win, I was proud to finish in the top thirty.
sentences.chinese: 我是马拉松中第二十三个冲过终点的人，尽管没赢，但能进前三十我感到很骄傲。
sentences.scene: 马拉松比赛的个人成就

sentences.english: Today is my parents' thirteenth anniversary.
sentences.chinese: 今天是我父母结婚三十周年纪念日。

sentences.english: She started her thirteenth year at the company with a promotion and a big raise.
sentences.chinese: 她在公司的第三十个年头以升职和大幅加薪开始。

sentences.english: On my thirteenth birthday, I decided to learn to play the guitar, and it was the scariest but best decision I ever made.
sentences.chinese: 十三岁生日那天，我决定学弹吉他，那是我做过的最吓人但也是最棒的决定。

sentences.english: Where is the other sock?
sentences.chinese: 另一只袜子在哪？

sentences.english: I have one more question; the other ones can wait until tomorrow.
sentences.chinese: 我还有一个问题，其他的可以等到明天再问。

sentences.english: Some people love the mountains, while other people prefer the beach, but I'm one of those lucky ones who enjoys both equally.
sentences.chinese: 有些人喜欢山，另一些人喜欢海滩，但我是那种两者同样喜欢的幸运儿。

sentences.english: Today is a very special day.
sentences.chinese: 今天是一个非常特别的日子。
sentences.scene: 提醒家人今天是重要日子

sentences.english: My grandma made a special cake for my birthday with rainbow layers.
sentences.chinese: 我奶奶为我的生日做了一个特别的彩虹层蛋糕。

sentences.english: This old watch isn't expensive, but it's special to me because my dad gave it to me before I left for college.
sentences.chinese: 这块旧表不贵，但对我很特别，因为是我上大学前爸爸给我的。
sentences.scene: 一件有情感价值的物品

sentences.english: Show me your drawing, please.
sentences.chinese: 请给我看看你的画。

sentences.english: We watched a comedy show last night and laughed until our stomachs hurt.
sentences.chinese: 昨晚我们看了一场喜剧表演，笑到肚子疼。

sentences.english: My favorite TV show from when I was a kid just got a reboot, and watching the first episode brought back so many memories.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候最喜欢的电视节目刚刚重启了，看第一集就勾起了好多回忆。
sentences.scene: 经典剧集重启引发怀旧

sentences.english: The Spring Festival is a time for family.
sentences.chinese: 春节是家人团聚的时刻。

sentences.english: Our town holds a music festival every summer in the park.
sentences.chinese: 我们镇每年夏天在公园举办音乐节。

sentences.english: I love the lantern festival because the whole park lights up with thousands of glowing lanterns, and it feels like walking through a dream.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢灯节，因为整个公园都被成千上万个发光的灯笼照亮，感觉像在梦中漫步。

sentences.english: Look at that cute little kitten!
sentences.chinese: 看那只可爱的小猫！
sentences.scene: 在宠物店或街头看到小猫

sentences.english: We adopted a tiny kitten from the shelter, and she follows me everywhere.
sentences.chinese: 我们从收容所领养了一只小猫咪，她到处跟着我。

sentences.english: When I was little, I found a stray kitten in the backyard, and my parents let me keep her, which started my lifelong love for cats.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候在后院发现了一只流浪小猫，爸妈让我留下她，从此我便一生都爱猫。
sentences.scene: 童年收养流浪猫的经历

sentences.english: I write in my diary every night.
sentences.chinese: 我每晚都写日记。

sentences.english: I found my old diary from middle school, and it was so embarrassing to read.
sentences.chinese: 我找到了中学时的旧日记，读起来太尴尬了。

sentences.english: My grandmother kept a diary during the war, and reading her words makes me feel so connected to her and grateful for the peaceful life I have.
sentences.chinese: 我奶奶在战争期间写日记，读她的文字让我感觉与她那么相连，也感恩我拥有的和平生活。

sentences.english: I'm still waiting for the bus.
sentences.chinese: 我还在等公交车。

sentences.english: Even though it's late, the kids are still running around and not sleepy at all.
sentences.chinese: 虽然很晚了，孩子们还在跑来跑去，一点也不困。

sentences.english: It's been ten years since we graduated, but we still meet up once a month, and it feels like no time has passed at all.
sentences.chinese: 我们毕业已经十年了，但依然每月聚一次，感觉就像时间从未流逝。

sentences.english: What's that strange noise outside?
sentences.chinese: 外面那是什么奇怪的声音？

sentences.english: The construction noise from next door is driving me crazy all week.
sentences.chinese: 隔壁装修的噪音这一整周都快把我逼疯了。

sentences.english: I was trying to study, but the noise from the party downstairs was so loud that I couldn't concentrate, so I ended up going to a café.
sentences.chinese: 我正想学习，但楼下派对的噪音太吵了，我无法集中精神，所以只好去了咖啡馆。
sentences.scene: 因噪音而更换学习场所

sentences.english: The rabbit's fur is so soft.
sentences.chinese: 那只兔子的毛好软。

sentences.english: My coat has a fake fur collar that looks real and keeps me warm.
sentences.chinese: 我的外套有个仿皮草领子，看起来像真的，还很暖和。

sentences.english: Our dog sheds so much fur that we have to vacuum the living room every single day, but we still wouldn't trade her for anything.
sentences.chinese: 我们家的狗掉毛太厉害了，我们每天都得吸尘客厅，但我们还是不会拿她去换任何东西。

sentences.english: Can you open the window, please?
sentences.chinese: 你能把窗户打开吗？

sentences.english: The store is open until 9 p.m., so we still have time to shop.
sentences.chinese: 商店开到晚上九点，我们还有时间逛。
sentences.scene: 确认营业时间后松一口气

sentences.english: I tried to open the jar of pickles for ten minutes, and when my little sister opened it in one second, I felt both relieved and a little embarrassed.
sentences.chinese: 我试着开那罐腌黄瓜开了十分钟，结果我妹妹一秒就打开了，我既松了一口气又有点尴尬。

sentences.english: Let's walk to the park together.
sentences.chinese: 我们一起走去公园吧。

sentences.english: I take my dog for a walk every morning before work.
sentences.chinese: 我每天早上上班前都带狗去散步。

sentences.english: After a big dinner, my family likes to take a long walk around the neighborhood, looking at Christmas lights and chatting about our day.
sentences.chinese: 大餐之后，我们一家喜欢在小区里走一大圈，看看圣诞灯饰，聊聊一天的事。
